name: Shell Archmage
body:
Shell Archmage CR 20

XP 307,200
CE Medium humanoid

Init +8; Senses all-around vision (areas with cameras), low-light vision; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 16, flat-footed 21 (+8 armor, +3 deflection, +3 Dex)
hp 122 (20d6+40)
Fort +11, Ref +14, Will +17; +2 vs. enchantment; Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +2 quarterstaff +11/+6 (1d6+1)
Special Attacks hand of the apprentice (12/day), metamagic mastery (7/day)
Wizard Spells Prepared (CL 20th; concentration +29 Save DC 14 + spell-level

9th—empowered delayed blast fireball, mage’s excellent enclosure, meteor swarm (2, time stop
8th—polar ray (2), power word stun (2), prismatic wall
7th—delayed blast fireball, finger of death, firebrand (2), reverse gravity
6th—chain lightning (2), cloak of dreams, greater dispel magic, mage’s lucubration
5th—cloudkill, dominate person, suffocation, teleport (2), wall of force
4th—bestow curse, crushing despair, enervation, greater invisibility, lesser globe of invulnerability, maximized magic missile
3rd—dispel magic, fireball (2), fly, haste (2)
2nd—ghoul touch, stilled magic missile, scorching ray (2)
1st—magic missile (3), ray of enfeeblement (2), shield, true strike
0 (at will)—detect magic

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 16, Con 11, Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 18
Base Atk +10; CMB +9; CMD 35
Feats Combat Casting, Combat Expertise, Deep Focus, Eschew Materials, Greater Spell Penetration, Improved Counterspell, Psionic Meditation, Psionic Shot, Speed of Thought, Wild Talent
Skills Acrobatics +10, Autohypnosis +16, Bluff +18, Diplomacy +24, Disguise +18, Escape Artist +15, Fly +20, Perform (dance) +14, Sense Motive +16, Spellcraft +27, Swim +12
Languages Aklo, Binary, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Sylvan
SQ arcane bond (quarterstaff), elven magic
Gear metamagic gems (2 empowering topazes, 1 maximizing sapphire, 2 quickening diamonds, 1 widening emerald), +2 quarterstaff, blessed book, bracers of armor +8, cloak of resistance +5, headband of vast intelligence +6, ring of protection +3, spell component pouch
